verdict.rationale: Published operating hours, per-day submission limits, and session timeouts are a fair question for an online government filing system, but the evidence pack never states any of them. The nearest items are a fallback for when the payment system is unavailable and a note on queueing multiple applications; neither publishes a window, limit, or timeout up front. The pre-start account and MFA wall is a different requirement and earns no credit here.
